meta.niche: Vacation rental and short-term rental property management software (channel manager, PMS, direct booking)

analysis.summary: Hostaway runs a refresh push on its big guide library, with 41 updates and 7 new pages. Rivals publish few new pages and aim at buyers or current customers.

points.text: Hostaway updated 41 older pages and added 7. No rival comes close on updates, so Hostaway is keeping its learning content fresh.
Lodgify refreshed 14 product pages on channel manager, tasks and payments, aimed at buyers. Hostaway has just 1 landing page in its mix.
Hospitable and Uplisting are adding new money and operations pages: payments, taxes, trust accounting, compliance and deposits. Hostaway's data shows none of these.

Hostaway.play: Refresh a huge guide library on platforms, laws and pricing, plus a few new pages.

Hospitable.play: Launch pages on payments, taxes and trust accounting (rules for holding client money) in 8 new pages.

OwnerRez.play: Announce integrations and share podcasts and industry news with its existing users.

Lodgify.play: Refresh product pages for channel manager, automation and payments, plus a free host summit.

Uplisting.play: Four new pages on onboarding, tasks, compliance and deposits.

shared.title: Task management pages
shared.text: Lodgify and Uplisting both have a task management software page. Operations tools are being sold next to the core channel manager. Hostaway's data shows no matching page.

shared.title: Money and compliance tools
shared.text: Hospitable and Uplisting publish on taxes, deposits, disputes or payments. Lodgify has a payment processing page too. Rivals pitch these as part of the software.

shared.title: Local partner and podcast stories
shared.text: Hospitable and OwnerRez both feature Localbird and podcast content. This is community building with partners, not search-driven content.

gaps.title: PMS payments and trust accounting
gaps.text: Hospitable has only a few pages on this and others touch it lightly. Hostaway could own a clear explainer-plus-product set.

gaps.title: Tax reporting and remittance guides
gaps.text: Only Hospitable published new tax pages. Hostaway's many law guides (Florida, France, Spain) could be tied to a tax tool story.

gaps.title: Channel manager buyer pages by platform
gaps.text: Lodgify has dedicated pages for Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com. Hostaway has 1 landing page, so it could build matching buyer pages from its guides.
